title: Report Modal
content: Build report modal for posts/users. Trigger: report option in post/user menu. Reason selection: radio buttons (Spam, Harassment, Violence, Misinformation, etc.). Additional info: optional textarea for details. Confirmation: thank you message after submit. Block option: offer to block user. Status tracking: report submitted indicator.

variants.simple: Create report content modal with reason selection.
variants.detailed: Build report modal for posts/users. Trigger: report option in post/user menu. Reason selection: radio buttons (Spam, Harassment, Violence, Misinformation, etc.). Additional info: optional textarea for details. Confirmation: thank you message after submit. Block option: offer to block user. Status tracking: report submitted indicator.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive report modal for content moderation. Trigger: "Report" option in post menu, user menu, or message menu. Modal: max-w-md, bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl. Header: "Report [Post/User/Message]" with Flag icon, close X button. Step 1 - What are you reporting?: content preview showing what's being reported (post snippet, user card, etc.). Step 2 - Select reason: radio group of report categories. Category groups: Spam or misleading (Spam, Scam, Misleading information), Abuse (Harassment or bullying, Hate speech, Violent threats), Harmful content (Violence, Adult content, Self-harm), Intellectual property (Copyright infringement, Trademark), Other (Something else with required text input). Each option: radio + label + brief description. Selecting reveals relevant sub-options if applicable. Step 3 - Additional context: textarea "Help us understand the issue" (optional for most reasons, required for "Something else"), attach screenshot button optional. Step 4 - Submit confirmation: "Report submitted" success message with Check icon, "Thank you for helping keep our community safe", reference ID for tracking. Additional actions offered: "Block [Username]" checkbox/button ("You won't see their content"), "Mute [Username]" option, "Unfollow" if following. What happens next: brief explanation "We'll review this report and take action if it violates our Community Guidelines. We may contact you if we need more information." Link to Community Guidelines. Status tracking: "View your reports" link to see submitted reports and their status (Under review, Action taken, No violation found). Urgent reports: for imminent harm categories, highlighted as priority with additional resources (crisis hotlines). Anonymous: note that reports are confidential, reported user won't know who reported. Multi-step flow: navigation with Back button, progress indicator optional. Rate limiting: prevent spam reports, "You've recently reported this" if duplicate. Mobile: full-screen modal, step-by-step flow. Accessibility: radio group properly structured, status changes announced, focus management between steps.
